content: 1. The American Statistician published an article in 2016 discussing the purpose and access of statistical methodologies in clinical research. 2. The GRADE system, as outlined in a 2008 BMJ article, represents a consensus on evaluating the quality of evidence and the strength of clinical recommendations. 3. The FDA released guidance in 2016 on the use of electronic informed consent in clinical investigations, addressing questions for institutional review boards, investigators, and sponsors. 4. A 2018 BMJ systematic review and meta-analysis examined the impact of patient and public involvement on enrollment and retention in clinical trials. 5. The World Health Organization (WHO) issued a joint statement in 2017 emphasizing the importance of public disclosure of clinical trial results. 6. The CONSORT 2010 Statement, published in the Journal of Clinical Epidemiology, provided updated guidelines for reporting parallel group randomized trials. 7. A 2024 BMJ article introduced the CONSORT-Surrogate extension checklist for reporting surrogate endpoints in randomized controlled trials, with detailed explanations and elaborations. 8. The WHO published a 2022 policy and implementation guidance on sharing and reusing health-related data for research purposes. 9. The WHO International Clinical Trials Registry Platform (ICTRP) serves as a global resource for clinical trial registration and was accessed in February 2024. 10. A 2008 Clinical Trials article discussed maintaining the confidentiality of interim data to enhance the integrity and credibility of clinical trials. 11. The ESSENCE and UKCDR Good Practice Document (2022) outlined four approaches to supporting equitable research partnerships. 12. The WHO provided guidance in 2022 for conducting research priority-setting exercises, aimed at assisting its staff in systematic decision-making. 13. The WHO Council on the Economics of Health for All released a report in 2023 on transforming economies to deliver health equity. 14. The GloPID-R Funders Living Roadmap for Clinical Trial Coordination, published in 2023, offers strategies for improving clinical trial infrastructure. 15. The Global Alliance for Chronic Diseases (GACD) focuses on addressing chronic disease research and was accessed in February 2024. 16. The Joint Programming Initiative on Antimicrobial Resistance (JPIAMR) addresses global challenges in antimicrobial resistance research. 17. The Global Research Collaboration for Infectious Disease Preparedness (GloPID-R) supports research coordination for infectious disease outbreaks. 18. The European & Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP) promotes clinical research partnerships between Europe and developing countries. 19. The Ensuring Value in Research (EViR) initiative aims to improve the value and impact of health research globally. 20. The Innovative Medicines Initiative (IMI) focuses on accelerating the development of innovative medicines in Europe. 21. The WHO Global Observatory on Health Research and Development provides data and analysis to support decision-making in health research. 22. The WHO published a 2022 guide for evidence-informed decision-making, emphasizing the use of robust evidence in policy development. 23. WHO recommendations from 2015 and 2024 address interventions to improve preterm birth outcomes, including the use of antenatal corticosteroids. 24. Cochrane systematic reviews from 2017 and 2020 evaluated the efficacy of antenatal corticosteroids in accelerating fetal lung maturation for women at risk of preterm birth. 25. The WHO Global Benchmarking Tool (GBT) for evaluating national regulatory systems of medical products was revised in 2021. 26. The WHO developed a tool for benchmarking ethics oversight of health-related research involving human participants, with a draft version available for piloting. 27. The Pan American Health Organization released a tool in 2023 for accrediting research ethics committees. 28. The European Medicines Agency (EMA) provides a Clinical Trials Information System to streamline clinical trial processes in Europe. 29. The Accelerating Clinical Trials in the EU (ACT EU) initiative aims to improve clinical trials to better address patient needs. 30. The NHS Health Research Authority offers an Integrated Research Application System to facilitate clinical research in the UK. 31. The WHO African Vaccine Regulatory Forum (AVAREF) provides guidance for emergency preparedness in vaccine regulation. 32. The SIDCER-FERCAP Foundation supports ethical review and accreditation of research ethics committees globally. 33. UNICEF, UNDP, the World Bank, and WHO collaborate on a special program for research and training in tropical diseases. 34. The International Coalition of Medicines Regulatory Authorities (ICMRA) promotes global collaboration among regulatory authorities. 35. The WHO issued guidance in 2022 for rapid review of research during public health emergencies. 36. The African Vaccine Regulatory Forum (AVAREF) developed a strategy for emergency preparedness in vaccine regulation. 37. The WHO R&D Blueprint for Epidemics outlines strategies for research and development during epidemic responses. 38. A 2023 White House roundtable discussed preparing the U.S. clinical trials infrastructure for emergencies. 39. The G7 100 Days Mission, launched in 2021, aims to respond to future pandemic threats within 100 days. 40. The Healthy Life Trajectories Initiative (HeLTI) focuses on improving health outcomes through early interventions. 41. A 2016 New England Journal of Medicine article reported on Phase 1 trials of the rVSV Ebola vaccine in Africa and Europe. 42. A 2017 article in Human Vaccines & Immunotherapeutics explored vaccine development and trials in lowand middle-income countries, highlighting challenges and opportunities. 43. The Global Health Network provides training and resources for clinical research, including the TDR Global Competency Framework. 44. The European Clinical Research Infrastructure Network (ECRIN) supports multinational clinical research in Europe. 45. The National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR) Clinical Research Network facilitates clinical research in the UK. 46. The Accelerating Clinical Trials (ACT) initiative in Canada aims to improve clinical trial efficiency and outcomes. 47. The Clinical Research Initiative for Global Health (CRIGH) promotes international collaboration in clinical research. 48. The Global Health Network (TGHN) offers resources and training for global health research. 49. The ARISE Alliance supports clinical research collaboration in ASEAN and East Asia. 50. The Indian Clinical Trial and Education Network (INTENT) focuses on advancing clinical research and education in India. 51. The African Union-European Union Innovation Agenda promotes collaboration in research and innovation between Africa and Europe. 52. The SPIRIT 2013 Statement defines standard protocol items for clinical trials to ensure transparency and quality. 53. The WHO supports National Immunization Technical Advisory Groups (NITAGs) to strengthen immunization programs globally. 54. The NITAG Maturity Assessment Tool (NMAT) evaluates the development and effectiveness of national immunization advisory groups. 55. The Academy of Medical Sciences promotes greener biomedical research practices to reduce environmental impact. 56. A 2023 Lancet Digital Health article discussed the ethical opportunities and challenges of decentralized clinical trials.
